I tried adding `reference` in all three.

Version 1 feels the most natural to me. The little box and the Add button are right there on the bookmark, so I type "reference," hit add, and the chip shows up — done in one step, no digging. That's how I'd want to tag things most of the time, quickly while I'm looking at the link.

Version 2 (having to open a "Labels" control first) felt like an extra click for no real gain. Version 3, the full edit panel, is actually nice — but that feels more like the place I'd go when I want to change several things at once (fix the title, add labels together), which is that "edit the bookmark" flow I mentioned earlier. So I'd keep something like Version 3 around for editing, but for just slapping a label on, Version 1 wins.

And yes — the label showing up as a small chip beneath the details looks right to me. Clear and out of the way.

One thing I'd want when I'm typing a label, though: as I start typing, I'd like it to suggest labels I've already used, so I don't accidentally make "reference" and "References" and "ref" as three separate ones. I want to be able to reuse the same label consistently. Can you keep that in mind for the label typing?
